name: Tunnelmole Open-Source Self-Hosted Tunnels
free_limit: Self-hostable reverse-tunneling service and CLI for exposing local HTTP servers through a public URL, without software usage quotas; server AGPL-3.0 and client MIT.
watch_out: You supply and secure the public server, domain, bandwidth and TLS reverse proxy; the self-hosted server has no native HTTPS. AGPL-3.0 network-use obligations apply to modified server code; vendor-hosted service and paid custom domains are not part of this self-hosted offering.
